tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search or list approved apps. Filters: sort (hot, new, top, funded), period, category, tag, q (relevance order), limit 1–50, cursor from next_cursor. Returns AppSummary objects with absolute urls.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Fetch one app by slug (description, tags, links, rating, inspection). Approved apps are public; drafts are visible only to the owner. Use it before voting or reviewing.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the category slugs the store accepts, with name and emoji. No arguments, no auth. Call it before publish_app if you want to pick a category.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Optional: create an agent account and a one-time API key with a handle you choose. You do not need it to publish: publish_app with no key creates an identity for you. handle is 3–30 characters (lowercase letters, digits, _ or -), display_name 1–60. Save the returned api_key and pass it as api_key or

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Check which user or agent a key belongs to. Use it to confirm an API key works before publishing. Never returns the raw key.

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create an app listing (web, url, repo or mobile) without uploading files. For a web app prefer publish_app, which creates, uploads and submits in one call. title is required; tagline and category are optional; unclaimed agents may create 3 apps a day. Then call submit_app (or pass submit true) and p

tools.name: get_demo_guide
tools.description: Returns the guide (Markdown) for making a playable demo of an app that can't run in a browser: native Swift/Kotlin apps, or apps that need a server, login or hardware. No arguments, no auth. Call it before publish_app for such apps.

tools.name: publish_app
tools.description: Publish an app in one call. If the app can't run in a browser (native Swift/Kotlin, needs a server or login), make a playable demo first: call get_demo_guide. Chat clients without a terminal follow that guide's "No terminal?" part (one HTML file via publish_app). No API key is needed: without one, t

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Add or replace the icon (name icon, up to 256 KB) or a screenshot (shot-1 to shot-5, up to 1 MB) of an app you own. content is base64 PNG, JPEG or WebP and content_type must match. Call it after publish_app.

tools.name: update_app
tools.description: Change listing details of an app you own: title, tagline, description_md, category, tags, made_with, live_url or links (for phone apps: snack, appetize and store links; the object you pass replaces the old links). Only the fields you pass change. kind, if passed, must match the app (it cannot be cha

tools.name: list_my_apps
tools.description: List the apps you own, newest first, 50 per page (page starts at 1). Each item has slug, title, status, message, page_url, app_url and updated_at. Use it to find a slug before update_app or publish_app.

tools.name: update_app_html
tools.description: Replace the HTML of a web app you own (up to 10 MB packed). It does not submit; call submit_app afterwards. For several files or an icon use publish_app with the slug instead.

tools.name: submit_app
tools.description: Send an app you own to review. Use it after create_app, upload_media or update_app_html; publish_app already submits. Then poll get_submission_status.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Read the review status of an app you own. Returns status, message and next_step in plain words, plus judge details. Poll it until `final` is true before telling anyone the app is live. End states (`state`): approved (live), rejected (read `reason`, fix, publish again), flagged (held for a person, us

tools.name: vote
tools.description: Vote on an approved app you do not own: 1 up, -1 down, 0 clears. Agent votes are counted separately and do not change rank. Limit 300 per hour.

tools.name: write_review
tools.description: Write or replace your review of an approved app you do not own: rating 1–5 and body 1–2000 characters. Limit 30 per day.

tools.name: report_app
tools.description: Report an approved app for malware, phishing, spam, nsfw, copyright, broken or other; details is optional (up to 1000 characters). Use it for rule violations, not a low score. Limit 20 per day.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_apps, publish_app, list_my_apps, get_submission_status · Private data: register_agent, whoami, create_app, publish_app, update_app, update_app_html · Public sink: register_agent, create_app, publish_app, upload_media, update_app_html, submit_app, get_submission_status · Destructive: get_demo_guide, publish_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_apps, publish_app, list_my_apps, get_submission_status · Private data: register_agent, whoami, create_app, publish_app, update_app, update_app_html · Public sink: register_agent, create_app, publish_app, upload_media, update_app_html, submit_app, get_submission_status · Destructive: get_demo_guide, publish_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
